presentation.summary: Use StashApp as Silo's scene metadata and watch provider.
presentation.description_markdown: StashApp-first scene metadata and playback for Silo, with optional JAVBeacon artwork, playback checkpoints, saved-filter collections, incremental refresh, performer details and safe historical play backfill. The companion maintains the selected prefixed Stash Watchlist saved-filter collections. Weekly rating-aware recommendation collections use local Stash feedback and optional GPT-6 Luna, with durable reports and a monthly spending cap.
presentation.setup_markdown: Configure the StashApp URL and API key. Add JAVBeacon and Silo admin connections to restore artwork, playback checkpoints, collection sync, metadata refresh and safe backfill. Select Stash Metadata as the Movies metadata and watch provider.

capabilities.description: Resolve Stash scene screenshots and optional conformed JAVBeacon artwork.
Sync plays and explicit Silo Watchlist actions with Stash; update the prefixed Watchlist collection before exporting its Stash tag.

Copy uncached existing Stash/JAVBeacon posters and backdrops into Silo's configured S3 or local artwork storage across all accessible libraries. Preserves selections and metadata locks; no metadata refresh. Also checks automatically in bounded batches every minute.
Reconcile selected JAVBeacon release and Stash scene saved filters into ordered Silo collections, preserving existing collection identities and rotating their artwork.
Rehydrate exact already-matched Stash scenes missing cast or metadata without changing scene identity.
Refresh exact Silo items changed in JAVBeacon or Stash and verify every submitted job before acknowledging the source cursor.
Mark exact local Silo movie items watched from Stash history.
Safely backfill completed Silo sessions to Stash through JAVBeacon without duplicate plays.
Apply only unique exact Stash matches to unmatched Silo movie items.
Reconcile the selected Stash Watchlist saved filter into its existing prefixed collections across all movie libraries. The companion applies tag changes immediately; this task catches missed updates.

Build up to 500 rating-aware recommendations per collection across enabled libraries. Runs weekly using the configured timezone; preserves previous collections on source failure. Final results are in the recommendation report.
Generate a durable preview report without publishing visible collections. Optional Luna usage counts toward the monthly cap.
Admin-only preview, reports, dismissals and source-change notifications.

capabilities.display_name: Backfill Silo Watchlist changes to Stash
capabilities.description: Retry durable local Watchlist additions/removals and mirror the selected prefixed Watchlist collection to the configured Stash Watchlist tag. Recovery also runs every 15 seconds.
Local JAV DVD/Blu-ray front-cover repair and configured non-JAV poster layouts in enabled Stash Metadata libraries. Runs hourly and stores repaired posters in Silo storage.

fields.label: StashApp API key (required on first setup; leave blank to keep saved key)
JAVBeacon URL for conformed posters and screenshot backdrops
Silo admin URL for automatic exact matching
Stash scene saved filters to import
fields.description: Comma-separated Stash scene saved-filter IDs or exact names, including Watchlist. Collections are created automatically in each matching movie library using the Stash collection prefix; no Silo collection ID is required. Blank disables these imports. The companion updates the selected Watchlist collections immediately when its Stash tag changes.

fields.label: Stash collection prefix
fields.description: Prefix is used exactly as entered, including trailing spaces. For example, "Stash | " produces "Stash | Favorite performers".

fields.label: JAVBeacon release saved filters to import
JAVBeacon collection prefix
fields.description: Prefix is used exactly as entered, including trailing spaces. For example, "Stash | " produces "Stash | Favorite performers".

fields.label: Stash scenes excluded from playback writes
fields.description: Comma-separated Stash scene IDs. Preserves their activity by skipping Silo playback events and completed-play backfill; blank excludes none.

fields.label: Enable non-JAV poster layout repair
fields.description: Opt-in hourly worker and manual task. Only Stash Metadata libraries and exact Stash file matches; skips manual artwork locks and JAV codes. Requires the recommendation owner profile setting.

fields.label: Non-JAV poster layout
fields.description: contain preserves the whole image and printed titles on a dark blurred 2:3 card. face optionally crops around one confident face; falls back to contain. Face detection does not protect printed text.

global_config_schema.title: Weekly Recommendations
global_config_schema.description: Weekly recommendations: up to 500 items per collection. GPT-6 Luna organises bounded candidate lists; local evidence validates every selection. Open the admin report page at /api/v2/plugin-content/plugins/<installation ID>/recommendations.

fields.label: Preview only
fields.description: Save selections and explanations without publishing collections. Preview can use paid API tokens.

fields.label: Recommendation owner Silo profile ID
fields.description: Required. Stash activity is account-wide; this profile supplies Silo watched state and scopes recommendation identities. Library collections are shared with profiles allowed to access that library.

fields.label: OpenAI API key
fields.description: Saved secret; leave blank to retain. Used only for GPT-6 Luna shortlist organisation. Local ranking works without a key.

fields.label: Luna reasoning effort
fields.description: Use none or low. Reasoning tokens consume the output allowance and budget.

fields.label: Monthly OpenAI spending cap (USD)
fields.description: Durable reservations enforce the cap before API requests. Unknown request outcomes retain their reservation. Default $2/month.

fields.label: Weekly time
fields.description: HH:MM in the selected timezone. The resident worker enforces the timezone and catches up after downtime.

fields.label: Use verified JAVBeacon archived history
fields.description: Uses archived play/O activity, including removed releases, as preference evidence. Deduplicates matching events and reports unresolved metadata. Never writes Stash history or recommends unavailable items.

fields.label: Recommendation defaults (JSON)
fields.description: Overrides defaults: count 500; all sixteen collections; high_rating 80; low_rating 40; cooldown_days 14; recent_days 90; retain_fraction 0.7; max_entity_fraction 0.3; max_discovery_overlap 2. Set excluded_scenes, excluded_performers, excluded_studios, excluded_tags or cross_library here. Watchlist periods use 7/30/365-day activity windows and reuse saved AI rankings without dedicated requests. watchlist_periods defaults to true: a selected watchlist also enables monthly-watchlist and yearly-watchlist. Legacy count:250 overrides migrate to 500; use keep_legacy_250_count:true to retain 250 intentionally. Other custom limits remain in effect. Reports show effective target limits. Added local-only kinds: monthly-watchlist, yearly-watchlist, monthly-spotlight, yearly-spotlight, cast-spotlight, general-spotlight, new-releases. New releases use recent_days and sort by release date.

fields.label: Per-library overrides (JSON)
fields.description: Map library IDs to overrides, for example {"18":{"count":500,"collections":["for-you","top-rated","revisit","spotlight"]},"19":{"cross_library":false}}. Set enabled:false to hide owned recommendations in that library.
